params.prompt: Notebook screen 'Defter' (pushed page). Diagonal-cut header with an illustration of an open notebook with a lighthouse sketch. A pill segmented control with three tabs 'İfadeler' (active), 'İpucu panosu', 'Konu setleri'. A white review card with a yellow progress ring showing '5' and text '5 ifadenin tekrar zamanı geldi · ~2 dk' and a yellow pill button 'Tekrara başla'. Then a list of rounded white rows each with a small colored episode badge ('B1', 'B2'), an English phrase in bold, Turkish meaning in grey, and a speaker icon. High-fidelity mobile app UI mockup, single iPhone screen, portrait, flat front view, no device frame, for 'hiVelzon', an English-learning app built around an animated coastal mystery story. Design system: warm sand background (#F7F1E6), white rounded cards (12px corners) with soft warm shadows, deep sea blue (#1F4E79) for titles and accents, lighthouse yellow (#F2B33D) pill-shaped primary buttons, evening orange (#E98A3C) small accents, small caps orange labels, rounded friendly bold headings (Nunito style) and clean body text (Inter style), 8px grid, generous whitespace, playful but calm, illustrated graphic-novel art inside shaped headers (wave or diagonal cut). Bottom navigation with 5 tabs: 'Ana Sayfa', 'Keşfet', 'Hikâye', 'Konuş', 'Profil', and a small round glowing speech-bubble mascot with two friendly eyes floating at bottom-right above the tab bar. Turkish UI text, legible, minimal. No ads, no hearts/lives, no timers, no leaderboards, no real brand logos.
